mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cinesquare (category, title, content, author_id, created_at, views) VALUES (#{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cinesquare WHERE category = #{category} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cinesquare WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND author_id = #{authorId}
